ATTACHMENTA
PROJECT DESCRIPTION
2721 N. MONTICELLO AVE. CHICAGO, IL. 60647

Proposed land use: The proposed use of the subject property will be for the
development of a multi-unit (3+ units) residential building.

17-13-0303-C Contents of Type 1 Rezoning Application. In addition to the
information required by the Zoning Administrator to be submitted with any other
Zoning Map Amendment application, the following additional information must be
submitted with all Type 1 applications:

A. Project’s floor area ratio: 0.67

B. Project’s density (lot area per dwelling unit to be established): 1,566.25 Square Feet
per dwelling unit

C. Amount of off-street parking present in the proposed project: 4 parking stalls (2 car
garage and 2 parking stalls via a concrete pad)

D. Setbacks for the project:

a. Front setback will be 13.52’ with no change from the existing structure,

b. North side yard setback will be 2.08’ with no change from the existing
structure but a reduction from 4’ required,

c. South side yard setback will 17.67’ which is no change from the existing
structure,

d. Combined side yard setback will be 19.75’, and

e. Rear setback will be 37.59’ with no change from the existing structure.

E. Building height will be 38”
